hypothesis: The private original managed test's prepare() instruments and writes each SHA-pinned original C# sequentially. A later instrumentation validation failure or disk write exception may leave earlier C# originals modified, breaking provenance for downstream checks.
scope: Source-only CI preparation; not genuine .rgd runtime, not APK build
strategy: Reproduce partial mutation synthetically; precompute all instrumentation before writing; verify rollback of every attempted write on I/O errors; use existing no-LFS original managed integration workflow. Keep original metadata untouched.
checks: original byte-for-byte preservation if later instrumentation fails
rollback of previously written adapted source on write exception
successful in-place source adaptation when all validated
limits: Not a transaction covering unrelated harness generation or disk failure during restoration
No Unity build, assets or release
